mode: generate with one local style reference
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: supplemental top-down/isometric board-game object sprite master for a 15x15 mystery puzzle
Primary request: Create exactly six isolated observatory objects arranged in a clean 3 columns by 2 rows atlas: (1) brass astronomical telescope on a compact tripod, (2) vintage vacuum-tube radio console, (3) sealed maritime filing cabinet, (4) riveted backup generator, (5) red-and-cream lifebuoy on a small stand, (6) frosted-glass beacon lamp on a brass base.
Input image: the supplied object-kit/v3 master is the strict style reference.
Scene/backdrop: uniform warm off-white background, wide empty gutters between every object, no decorative environment.
Style/medium: match the reference exactly: friendly flat hand-drawn 2D board-game illustration, thick dark charcoal-purple outlines, gently irregular ink line, restrained cel shading, subtle grounding shadow.
Composition/framing: one centered object per atlas cell, consistent apparent scale, full object visible, no cropping, no overlap, no labels.
Color palette: muted sage, dusty lavender, honey brass, fog blue, warm cream; only the lifebuoy may use muted brick red.
Constraints: all six objects must share identical line weight, perspective, lighting, and rendering treatment with the reference; object silhouettes must read clearly when reduced to a small game tile; no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
Avoid: photorealism, painterly texture, 3D render, neon cyberpunk, black background, checkerboard transparency preview, complex floor plane, dramatic lighting.
